claims.text: In the bounded \(a=1,b=2\) box/Pieri setting defined below, the Schur columns and all generators of the Pieri-row lattice are complete in degrees \(d+1\) and \(d+2\).

For \(p=c=1\), the degree-\(d+2\) row matrix, with rows \((2),(3),(4)\) and columns \((x_2,z,y_2)\), is \[ \begin{pmatrix}0&1&1\\1&1&0\\0&1&1\end{pmatrix}. \] Its rows \((2),(3)\) on columns \((z,y_2)\) form \[ \begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix},\qquad\det=-1. \]
